standard_form: Lai-Lim (m,n)=(5,5) reconstructed SDP, full size 187 with one scalar coordinate plus six 31x31 blocks

block_certificate.support: scalar coordinate plus six independent 31x31 blocks; no cross-block terms
block_certificate.method: exact SymPy LDL decomposition over rationals for each 31x31 block of -M

remaining_formalization_gap: The certificate is exact and independently verified in Python, but not yet encoded/proved in Lean. The separate PSD spectral norm identity ||S^k||_2=||S||_2^k remains the main Lean formalization blocker.
